historicalCombined.calculation: Count-weighted average of three displayed cohort means, rounded to two decimals.

interpretation: The new tutorial is about 5% above the pooled historical baseline, but about 5% below the most recent historical day's cohort. This does not establish an improvement in playtime.
methodology: Both families use the same ST_FirstSessionSeconds event; sample sizes count those event records.
Original filters: A/B/C, tutorial_order_v2, enrollment segments new:2026-10-27 through new:2026-10-29. Type 2 filters: Type2_A/B/C, tutorial_types_v1, new:2026-10-30.
Dates refer to enrollment segments generated in UTC, rather than chart timestamp labels that may display a different local day.
Only first sessions with an available end event are included. Today's ongoing sessions are excluded; historical cohorts are more mature.
Day, traffic mix, device mix and other updates can affect historical comparisons. No causal or statistically conclusive lift is claimed.
Oct 27 has only nine events and a large mean. It is included in the pooled result.
The earlier 24% figure used today's control of 82 ended first sessions and an earlier Type 2 snapshot of 309. It was not a comparison with all prior days.
The later Type 2 query returned 317 end events and a mean of 254.34 seconds. The earlier snapshot had 309 and 257.51 seconds. Neither is a fully mature cohort.

earlierSavedProfileSnapshot.note: Incomplete for Oct 29; uses stored per-profile durations. Primary comparison uses the same dashboard event for old and new.
